title: Mishka and Divisors
statementMd:
After playing with her beautiful array, Mishka decided to learn some math. After learning how to multiply, divide and what is divisibility, she is now interested in solving the following problem.

You are given integer $*k*$ and array $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ of $*n*$ integers. You are to find **non-empty** subsequence of array elements such that the product of its elements is divisible by $*k*$ and it contains minimum possible number of elements.

Formally, you are to find a sequence of indices $1 ≤ *i*_{1} < *i*_{2} < ... < *i*_{*m*} ≤ *n*$ such that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/aa500f5ad6a5aaa6f9fb4d61a026e28715f9865e.png) is divisible by $*k*$ while $*m*$ is minimum possible among all such variants.

If there are more than one such subsequences, you should choose one among them, such that sum of its elements is **minimum possible**.

Mishka quickly solved this problem. Will you do so?

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1 000$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{12}$).

The second line of the input contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{12}$) — array elements.

## Output

Print single positive integer $*m*$ in the first line — the number of elements in desired sequence.

In the second line print $*m*$ distinct integers — the sequence of indices of given array elements, which should be taken into the desired sequence.

If there are more than one such subsequence (e.g. subsequence of minimum possible number of elements and with minimum possible sum of elements), you can print any of them.

If there are no such subsequences, print $- 1$ in the only line.
statementZhMd:
在玩过她漂亮的数组后，Mishka 决定学习一些数学。在学会乘法、除法以及什么是整除后，她现在对解决下面的问题感兴趣。

给定整数 $*k*$ 和包含 $*n*$ 个整数的数组 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。你需要找到数组元素的一个**非空**子序列，使其元素乘积能被 $*k*$ 整除，并且所包含的元素数量尽可能少。

形式化地说，你需要找到一组下标 $1 ≤ *i*_{1} < *i*_{2} < ... < *i*_{*m*} ≤ *n*$，使得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/aa500f5ad6a5aaa6f9fb4d61a026e28715f9865e.png) 能被 $*k*$ 整除，同时 $*m*$ 在所有满足条件的方案中尽可能小。

如果有多个这样的子序列，你应当选择其中元素之和**尽可能小**的一个。

Mishka 很快就解决了这个问题。你也能做到吗？

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1 000$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{12}$）。

输入的第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{12}$）——数组中的元素。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个正整数 $*m*$——所求序列中的元素数量。

第二行输出 $*m*$ 个互不相同的整数——给定数组中应被选入所求序列的元素下标。

如果有多个这样的子序列（例如，元素数量最少且元素之和最小的子序列），你可以输出其中任意一个。

如果不存在这样的子序列，只在一行中输出 $- 1$。
